scope: Northeast Indiana regional execution with common disclosed study priors, explicit assumed development program and analyst proxy sites. Population projection to each scenario year uses an explicit zero-growth assumption pending regional projection evidence. Traffic/tourism remain disabled pending site-addressable inputs.
